thread.document:
In this assignment, I attempted to use Gemini 3 Pro (in Thinking mode) to solve all the coding portions of HW1. 

Things that were observed: 

1. In its chain-of-thought, Gemini repeatedly mentioned snippets similar to “understanding the user’s implicit constraints” while coding. (Some of these constraints were inferred correctly, while others were not). 

2. Gemini explicitly expressed its intent in setting new_stepsize to 1.1e-4 in order to demonstrate instability of standard GD while showing Momentum could still handle it. This shows that, beyond just producing executable code, it is able to reason about the underlying optimization dynamics and intentionally select parameters that serve the conceptual goal of this exercise.
